svg.text: Full traceability: design docs ’ requirements ’ tests ’ code

g.text: UR ’ EPIC ’ SCN ’ SR ’ TASK ’ TEST ’ CODE
Epic owns BDD scenarios; validated by E2E tests
(A change that violates one is wrong even if its tests pass)
Work not done = DEFERRED row with reason + link
Schema definitions (Zod/OpenAPI) are source of truth
Thresholds, rates, routing from versioned config
API/event ’ domain ’ DB ’ UI per slice
Deferrals, decisions, discoveries in LOG.md same session
Discoveries ’ PROPOSED row or BACKLOG immediately
Update dashboard + detail block + Totals together
UR: VALIDATED (all linked epics DONE + human approval)
 All INV-* enforced + annotated in code
 Status in all 3 places (dashboard, detail, totals)
 All SCN UPPER_VALIDATED · All SR LOWER_VERIFIED
 Human approval recorded in epic + WORKLIST

svg.text: Every change starts as a requirement with acceptance criteria, becomes a failing test, then traced code 
and anything we choose not to do is written down as a deferral, not forgotten.
